## Some data won't play {#slide-14}

```{=html}
<div class="s15-wrap">

      <span class="s15-dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>

      <span class="s15-ring"></span>
      <svg class="s15-arrow" viewBox="0 0 1000 660" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">

      </svg>

    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="s15-side">
    <div class="s15-fact a-fade" style="--d:7s"><span class="s15-big">86</span><span class="s15-lbl">tiles of 10°&#8202;×&#8202;10°</span></div>
    <div class="s15-fact a-fade" style="--d:7.6s"><span class="s15-big">× 41</span><span class="s15-lbl">layers each</span></div>
    <div class="s15-fact s15-total a-fade" style="--d:8.2s"><span class="s15-big">3,526</span><span class="s15-lbl">files, one click each</span></div>
    <div class="s15-script a-rise" style="--d:10s">

```

::: notes
Then there's the data you just can't virtualise. The JRC Tropical Moist Forest page has you click each tile, one at a time, and every file comes out of a Python script that ignores range requests and hands you the whole thing regardless.
:::
